allowedActions(EnumSet<NetWmState.State>, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean) - Static method in class org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.NetWmState
Derives the _NET_WM_ALLOWED_ACTIONS set from a window's state and capabilities, following the EWMH rules: CLOSE iff closable; MOVE is always offered; RESIZE only if resizable and neither maximized nor fullscreen; MAXIMIZE_VERT/HORZ only if maximizable and not fullscreen; MINIMIZE unless the window skips the taskbar; FULLSCREEN iff fullscreen-capable; ABOVE/BELOW are mutually exclusive with the current state: an ABOVE window is offered BELOW and vice versa, otherwise both.

The pure state machine for lg3d's life as the sole X session client on a bare-Xorg/LFS host (Phase G): the xinit/systemd hand-off starts it, it acquires the WM + compositor and runs, a clean logout tears it down in a fixed order, and a crash may be recovered up to a bounded number of times.

Creates a lifecycle allowing up to three crash recoveries.
